messages:
Maya (Support): Customer ACCT-9921 hitting 400 on POST /v1/rerank after they switched to sending batches as NDJSON. They say it works through their proxy. Can eng confirm if NDJSON is supported?

Ken (Eng): We currently expect a single JSON document (one top-level object with items array). NDJSON (newline-delimited multiple JSON docs) is not supported for rerank. Do we have their exact request body / correlation id?

Maya (Support): Pasting the body they sent (they concatenated two JSON docs with a newline):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  --data-binary $'{"items":[{"id":"1","query":"q1","candidates":[{"id":"a","text":"A"}]}]\n{"items":[{"id":"2","query":"q2","candidates":[{"id":"b","text":"B"}]}]}'
```
Response they get: 400 {"error":"invalid_request","message":"invalid JSON payload"}
Correlation id: cid_0a1b2c
Customer: "works on our local proxy that supports ndjson"

Ken (Eng): Confirmed on my side: when I POST two JSON docs concatenated the decoder errors with 'extra data after top-level value' / 'invalid JSON'. Our server uses a strict single-document JSON decoder for this endpoint because we perform batch validation and expect one schema instance.

Raj (Eng-runtime): Short-term workaround: have them send a single JSON document with an items array containing all items, e.g. `\{"items\":[item1,item2]}` or send separate requests per document. NDJSON support would require changes to request parsing, schema validation flow, and observability (we tag batched metrics per-request currently).

Maya (Support): Customer tried `Content-Type: application/x-ndjson` and still got 400. They said their pipeline implicitly streams NDJSON and they assumed the API would accept it.

Ken (Eng): For support, return a clearer error message guiding them to wrap into an array. Also we should not silently accept NDJSON because of atomic validation requirements. I'll draft a canned response plus minimal curl example to convert NDJSON to an array client-side.

Maya (Support): Filed internal ticket INF-4532, marked P2, linked the correlation id and customer repro. Asked product if NDJSON is a feature ask.

product-bot: Ticket INF-4532 created: "Support NDJSON or improve error messaging for rerank endpoint". Assigned: Raj (Eng-runtime).

Raj (Eng-runtime): I'll scope the change: (1) add a faster detection on the proxy to detect multiple top-level JSON docs and return a friendlier 400 with text: 'multiple JSON documents detected; send a single JSON object with items array' (2) evaluate NDJSON support feasibility as a separate work item.

Maya (Support): Sending canned reply to customer now with workaround and example. Will update once they confirm it's fixed on their side. :white_check_mark:
